test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18th November 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: FPI consists of securities and other financial assets passively held by foreign investors. What is the full form of FPI?
solution:
The correct answer is** **__**Foreign Portfolio Investment**__**.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Foreign portfolio investment** (FPI) involves an investor purchasing foreign financial assets.
 
• It is generally a **short-term investment**.
 
• Entry and Exit are** relatively easy.**
 
• FPI results in** only capital inflows.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• The FPI is an investment made by** non-residents** in Indian securities such as **shares, corporate bonds, infrastructure securities governmen**t bonds etc.
 
• The FPI investment regulate by **SEBI**
 
• **Mauritius** is the highest FPI investor in India(**as of Oct 2022**).
 
• **Singapore** is the second highest investor in India(as of Oct 2022).
 
• The** FPI was started in 1992**, as India opened up its economy and allowed the investment

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **About SEBI (As of August 2022)**

 
 
• The Securities and Exchange Board of India was constituted as a non-statutory body on **April 12, 1988 **
 
• It monitors and regulates the Indian capital and securities
 
• The current chairman of SEBI is** Madhabi Puri Buch**
